text_block_list.text: I think I ran pretty well today.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: How was the scenery from the lead?

text_block_list.text: Hehe, very pretty!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I think I'm going to be just fine.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It seems that running in the Kobe
Shimbun Hai
has helped Suzuka to feel
sure of the answer she
found at summer
camp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In consideration of this step forward, I
think we
should start putting together
her new agenda.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I've had my eye on the Kikuka Sho for a
while
now. But just as I'm about to bring
it up—
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Um, I actually have a request.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
The whole time I was racing today, I was
thinking
to myself—"this is who I am."
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
That thought is what pushed me past the
others
and into the lead. And the
scenery there was...
astounding.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Looking at it, I started to wonder.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
If I run against even faster opponents
and still
manage to take the lead, how
amazing will that
view be?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: That's why...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука looks at me with a look
of quiet
determination.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I want to run in the autumn Tenno Sho!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I'll be able to see sights there I
never
imagined!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho is the pinnacle of
the G1
medium-distance races. All of
the best
racers—including senior
racers—will be present.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I want to respect her wishes. In fact, with
her
prowess in medium-distance races,
winning the
autumn Tenno Sho isn't
beyond the realm of
possibility.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: But still, she needs more experience.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
All right then, let's make that our main
objective for next year!

text_block_list.text: All right!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
If we're going to take on the autumn
Tenno Sho,
then the long distance
Kikuka Sho won't help us
prepare. We'll
need a more suitable agenda.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We should be running in as many
medium G2
races—the same length as
the autumn Tenno
Sho—as we can. So
instead of the Kikuka Sho...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
Why don't we start by giving the Kinko Sho a
shot?

text_block_list.text: The Kinko Sho... Okay!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
So, we set our sights on the autumn
Tenno Sho,
using the upcoming Kinko
Sho as a stepping
stone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I have to make much more progress for
the
autumn Tenno Sho!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Seeing her so hopeful for what lies
ahead, I can't
help but think about how
much she's grown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
